game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the torchbearer must hold off giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den
core_gameplay_loop: In Spider Den, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Then check alert and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ore lift from giant bats in Spider Den: keep alert above zero until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 10, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
